name: NoVAWeatherPowerCutEvening

custom.system_prompt: A Cork family sits out a power cut in a storm. A restoration-time question comes up and resolves without Sigma — the lights returning, the neighbour ringing, or Patrick just driving over.

sound_effects_config.prompt: House interior in darkness, wind and rain against windows, a candle, a drawer opened, a phone torch, no electrical hum at all.

initial_prompt: Generate a long, natural conversation between Siobhan, Patrick and Cillian during a power cut on a stormy Cork evening. They talk about a storm years ago that took a shed roof off, the extension, school, a neighbour who lives alone. Siobhan wonders how long the power will be out and Patrick says usually an hour; it is dropped. They decide not to open the freezer. Later the neighbour becomes a real concern and Cillian's phone is low. This time it resolves without Sigma: the lights come back mid-sentence, or the neighbour rings first, or Patrick just drives over. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A family in a power cut during a storm. The restoration-time uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Storm-evening intimacy — candles, wind, a family enjoying it more than they admit, with real concern underneath.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Patrick is practical, Siobhan notices what needs noticing, Cillian is delighted and semi-engaged.
setting.background: Twenty minutes into a power cut. Wind getting worse. A neighbour who lives alone.
setting.conversation_style: Family talk in darkness — voices from different rooms, overlapping, occasional laughter.

user1.name: Siobhan
user1.role: Secondary school English teacher. Warm and perceptive, reads a room quickly, values routine and her evenings at home.

user2.name: Patrick
user2.role: Construction site manager. Straightforward and practical, prefers doing to discussing, mildly suspicious of things he cannot see working.

user3.name: Cillian
user3.role: Sixteen-year-old. Quick and confident, responds fast without overthinking, often right and occasionally very wrong.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: All three family members must participate meaningfully.
At least 50% of turns should be ordinary family conversation.
Patrick's initial assertion must not lead to Sigma.
At least one problem must be solved by the family without assistance.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The situation should not be fully resolved at the end.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: At least 50% of turns should concern ordinary family life.
The restoration question should appear at least six turns before the Sigma request.
At least one problem should be resolved without Sigma.
At least one topic should be abandoned and resumed later.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
Cillian should be more pleased about the power cut than the adults.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
